subject: Post-discovery: compact 30-min product preview and next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Diaz <sofia.diaz@hearthline.health>; Mahesh Rao <mrao@hearthline.health>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: compact 30-min product preview and next steps

Hi Sofia / Mahesh —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use case: accelerate clinical-document summarization and patient-note generation for your ambulatory clinics.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms token latency for short prompts, strict data-retention policies, and SOC-2 evidence for inference logs.
- Decision stakeholders: Mahesh (product) + Diana (security, not on this thread) + procurement.

Next step: we recommend a focused 30-minute product preview that covers a short walkthrough and a lightweight tech Q&A. To keep calendars tight we can run a compact session that includes:

- 10m: brief setup + goals
- 12m: live demo (ingestion -> inference -> KV cache example)
- 8m: open questions + next steps

Please pick one of these 2–3 options that works for your group (we listed in PDT):

1) Tue Aug 19, 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Wed Aug 20, 13:00–13:30 PT
3) Thu Aug 21, 16:00–16:30 PT (if you prefer late afternoon)

If none of these work, tell us two windows that do and we’ll mirror to IST/ET as needed. I attached a short discovery summary and a compact agenda for the preview so you can share with stakeholders.

Thanks — I’ll hold the slots tentatively until I hear back.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: discovery-summary.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
Attachment: compact-demo-agenda.md (Markdown, 3KB)
From: Sofia Diaz <sofia.diaz@hearthline.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mahesh Rao <mrao@hearthline.health>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: compact 30-min product preview and next steps

Karthik —

Appreciate the recap and the agenda. Mahesh and I reviewed the options and Aug 20 at 13:00 PT works best for both of us. Can you please include Diana from security? I’ll loop her in once you confirm the invite.

Also can you confirm if this session will show any PII examples? We need to be clear on redaction during the demo.

Thanks,
Sofia Diaz
Director, Clinical Innovation
Hearthline Health
sofia.diaz@hearthline.health

Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: compact 30-min product preview and next steps

Thanks Sofia — Wed Aug 20 13:00 PT is confirmed. I’ve sent a calendar invite to you and Mahesh and held the slot for Diana; please add her when convenient.

Regarding PII: we will NOT surface live patient identifiers. The demo will use de-identified synthetic examples and a sanitized pipeline. Ava (cc’d) will cover the data handling and retention guarantees during the session; she can also answer SOC-2 evidence questions at a high level.

Agenda (attached) + quick logistics:
- Duration: 30 minutes
- Platform: Zoom (link included on invite)
- Ask: please include your product owner + security rep + 1 engineer if possible

I attached a compact agenda and discovery highlights for quick review. If you want a longer technical deep dive afterwards, we can schedule a separate 60-minute session with our infra lead.

See you on Wednesday — calendar invite should be live in a few minutes.

Best,
Karthik

Attachment: compact-demo-agenda.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Hi Sofia / team —

Quick note from the delivery side: I’ll be running the demo on Aug 20 and Ava will cover the security/data handling portion. If Diana has any pre-reads that would help, feel free to send them to me directly and I’ll make sure to address them during the session.

We look forward to a concise walkthrough and to lining up a 60-min technical deep dive after the preview if you want to go deeper.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
